claim_checks.note: Table row 1 tracks the ledger wording (accumulation of junk, debris, garbage; fire, health or safety hazards; among listed conditions that can make a building substandard). No flat rule.
Insects, vermin or rodents, as determined by a health officer, condition of inadequate sanitation. Matches ledger.
Lack of adequate garbage and rubbish storage and removal facilities, as determined by a health officer, inadequate sanitation. Matches ledger.
Fire chief or deputy opinion, cause fire or explosion or ready fuel; matches ledger and keeps the opinion qualifier.
